description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role supports the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations and ensuring the highest standards of patient care within a skilled nursing facility environment. If you are a compassionate leader with a commitment to excellence, we encourage you to apply.This full-time position offers a competitive salary ranging from $60,000 to $75,000 per year, reflecting your valuable experience and qualifications. As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in staff supervision, quality assurance, and maintaining regulatory compliance, contributing significantly to the well-being of our residents.Take the next step in your nursing leadership career. We are looking for a professional who is ready to make a significant impact and foster a supportive and high-quality care environment. Apply today to learn more about this exciting opportunity.
requirements: Previous experience in a supervisory or leadership role within a skilled nursing facility
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $60,000 to $75,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
